parameters.caption: Cinematic Ethiopian heritage instrumental soundtrack. Gentle krar-inspired plucked strings, soft acoustic piano, warm ambient textures, subtle traditional percussion. Nostalgic rural childhood opening, gradually building emotional determination, hopeful inspirational ending. Restrained arrangement for documentary narration. No vocals.

Intimate emotional Ethiopian documentary instrumental. Soft masenqo-inspired bowed strings, delicate acoustic plucking, warm piano and atmospheric pads. Reflective opening, emotional middle, gentle uplifting resolution. Sparse arrangement, suitable beneath spoken narration. No singing or vocals.

Inspirational cinematic instrumental score about an Ethiopian farming childhood and technological innovation. Warm traditional acoustic textures evolving into subtle modern electronic ambience, gentle strings and restrained percussion. Nostalgic beginning, hopeful progressive build, peaceful ending. No vocals.
